headlines.text: Ethiopia’s Fano fighters claim capture of army vehicles and weapons. Armed fighters from Ethiopia’s Fano movement claim to have seized military trucks and weapons in the Amhara region.
Venezuelan government, opposition agree to work towards reform of top court. The two sides appointed a committee to review selection of candidates for Supreme Court of Justice.
Women take up arms as sexual violence ravages eastern DRC. As war and sexual violence rage in eastern DRC, women are joining pro-government Wazalendo fighters to defend themselves
At least 10 people killed in Russian and Ukrainian attacks. New strikes come as Russian FM accuses Europe of doing 'everything it can to thwart peace talks' with Ukraine.
Jerusalem Daily: violence continues as the world watches the UNGA. As the UN General Assembly enters its fifth day, with world leaders denouncing Israeli violence against Palestinians.
Manchester City confident they can prove ‘innocence’ over charges: Chairman. Man City to appeal 114 breaches of Premier League financial rules, chairman says club is confident of success.
LIVE: England vs Spain – UEFA Nations League. Follow the updates, with build-up, predictions, team news and lineups, from our live text commentary stream coverage.
Several hundred thousand people gather for Pope Leo’s mass in Paris. Vatican estimates 700,000 people in attendance as the Catholic religious leader continues four-day tour of France.
Thousands of students protest German military conscription. More than 40,000 students have taken to the streets of Berlin, in protest of Germany's proposed military service plans.
One year on, the UK’s recognition of Palestinian statehood is bearing fruit. The British government is moving to translate rhetoric into policy.
Trump rejects Iran’s seven-day roadmap to reopen Strait of Hormuz. Tehran submitted a proposal via Qatar to reopen the strait and resume nuclear talks within a week if Washington agreed.
Olympics: Germany picks Munich for Summer Games bid. Since the last time the Summer Games were on German soil in 1972, Germany has launched seven unsuccessful bids to host.
Israel-Ireland match to go ahead in Nations League after player vote. Ireland have delayed their pre-match media briefing and training as pressure grew, but player vote avoids game boycott.
Russell edges out Verstappen to win in Baku, Antonelli settles for fifth. George Russell wins Azerbaijan Grand Prix for eighth career F1 victory and first since the Austrian GP in June.
Is Ethiopia on the verge of another civil war as fighting erupts in Tigray?. Seven armed groups have joined forces against Abiy Ahmed’s government, bringing former enemies into the same alliance.

Reigning champion Indiana Hoosiers survive major scare from Northwestern in Big Ten opener. The National Champion Indiana Hoosiers barely survived Northwestern as penalties and Turbo Richard's injury nearly derailed their Big Ten opener.

Phillies shut out by Rays in opener of final regular-season series, pushing playoff hopes to the brink. Don Mattingly insists the Phillies aren't wilting, but 13 losses in 21 games and just two runs in 27 innings tell a different story down the stretch.

Doctor reveals '10-year rule' for evaluating brain fog and dementia symptoms. A UCLA neurology professor's 10-year self-assessment helps women determine if memory loss stems from estrogen changes during perimenopause or dementia.

Lynx coach Cheryl Reeve voices support for the trans community again after regular season finale vs Fever. Cheryl Reeve says her "Trans Kids Belong" shirt sparked an outpouring of messages from transgender families during a season defined by debate.

Fulton Sheen became a TV sensation preaching faith, morality and warnings Michael Knowles says still resonate. Conservative commentator says famous Catholic archbishop would be branded a "far-right extremist" today without changing his message on faith and communism.

WATCH: Former Dem Lt Gov reveals why he resigned after sexual harassment probe rocked state. Dale Caldwell called the ethics probe "specious" and "poorly done" on camera, insisting he resigned only to avoid distracting Gov. Mikie Sherrill.

UCF Knights unveil incredibly on-brand helmet sponsorship deal with Walt Disney World. UCF football unveiled a Walt Disney World helmet decal ahead of their Big 12 opener against TCU, pairing Orlando's most iconic brand with the Knights.

Bill Burr tells healthcare CEOs to probe what motivated Luigi Mangione instead of adding security. Bill Burr suggested the Luigi Mangione murder case should prompt healthcare executives to examine their policies rather than simply hiring security.

St Paul police chief sues mayor, alleging she called herself a 'MILF,' sexually harassed him and retaliated. Axel Henry's 73-page lawsuit accuses St. Paul Mayor Kaohly Her of explicit sexual comments, unwanted physical contact and a retaliation campaign.

Common kitchen staple may sharpen your brain, and it only takes 2 tablespoons. Eating about 2 tablespoons of tomato paste daily for three months boosted attention, processing speed and associative memory scores in a new study.

Soccer player gets smoked by lawn roller during halftime warm-up in wild moment caught on camera. Andros Townsend was hit by a lawn roller driven by grounds crew during a PT Prachuap match in Thailand, and the soccer accident sparked an investigation.

Fox News Entertainment newsletter: William won't repeat Charles’ jealousy; Harry's push sparks ‘contradiction’. The Fox News Entertainment Newsletter brings you the latest Hollywood headlines, celebrity interviews and stories from Los Angeles and beyond.

Massachusetts Communist Party chapter attacks Boston Globe over lesbian bar story. A Communist Party chapter accused The Boston Globe of courting far-right outrage with its reporting on a Greenfield, Massachusetts, lesbian bar's mask policy change.

Family of paralyzed Marine vet allegedly shot by migrant speaks out as health issue could delay testimony. Jimmy Friesenhahn, a Marine veteran paralyzed in a San Antonio shooting, faces a health crisis before trial, his family told Fox News Digital.

Olympic champion Nancy Hogshead honored for advocacy as she pushes WNBA on female eligibility rules. Nancy Hogshead wore an XX-XY Athletics shirt to the ceremony as 520 Olympians and Paralympians back her petition for female-only WNBA eligibility.
